installer_bug.root_cause: bytes.wait bug: detach=False returns bytes (logs), not Container; calling .wait() on bytes fails. Also no timeout, no fail-closed.
installer_bug.fix: detach=True + bounded timeout 600s + fail-closed verification. If install fails or verification fails, raise RuntimeError and rollback tenant.
installer_bug.verification: After install, query ir_module_module for installed state, compare to to_install, raise if missing

fail_closed.code: _install_package_modules raises RuntimeError on failure, provision_manual_uat_request does not catch it (no try/except around call), so tenant is rolled back and request marked failed
fail_closed.proof: Line 855-858: _install_package_modules called without try/except, failure propagates to outer except which marks request failed and cleans up tenant
fail_closed.test: If module install fails, tenant not marked ready, request status=failed, no ready tenant created

public_url.description: Open Odoo / public_url must not store or present localhost for Windows
public_url.presentation: UI uses external_urls built via build_external_odoo_url (HELPERS_CLOUD_EXTERNAL_HOST=100.76.217.35) or tenant.public_url (Tailscale), never localhost
public_url.validation: cloud_external_url.py rejects localhost/127.0.0.1 as invalid host, fail-closed if not configured
public_url.evidence: instances.html and instance_detail.html use external_urls/external_url, not internal_url
